_note: Fallback scripts for agents with no file of their own. Picked by name, so a take is repeatable. Exists because the board draws each agent's last line, and twenty rows of 'Ready.' would look staged.

steps.text: Auditing the key-rotation path for anything that assumes a single active key.
Tracing where usage records are written twice under a retry.
Backfilling types for the billing webhook payloads.
Reading the gateway's timeout budget end to end before touching it.
Splitting the dashboard's usage query — it fans out per key and doesn't need to.
Checking that every 4xx the gateway returns has a documented code.
Reproducing the flake in the key-expiry suite before changing anything.
Drafting the migration that adds the per-plan ceiling column.
